Did you know?

page.overview:
What is Angels of the Grail?

The Angels of the Grail are a Loyalist Space Marine Chapter who are successors of the Blood Angels raised during an unknown Founding. Their Chapter planet is known as Eden.

The Angels of the Grail's colour scheme is not listed in current Imperial records.

The Angels of the Grail's Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
